Q: How can I control the shutdown order of Spring-managed beans that I don’t create myself? A:

I think you can override any spring boot bean with your own, if you look into their code, a MeterRegistryCloser bean is created in that autoconfig, you can probably override/inherit it and add custom conditions to close the meter registry only after a certain condition is met.

Not sure how you would implement those conditions to check if other beans have been closed, I guess it really depends on your implementation.

You'd need to also make sure to close it properly before the liveness probe changes, since k8s will kill the pod after that.

Q: Removing Conda environment A:

To remove the complete Conda environment:

conda remove --name YOUR_CONDA_ENV_NAME --all

Q: How to add additional columns with a Left Join without losing values in columns from right table? A:

It seems to be your expectation is to get the sum of Leads, Purchases and Revenue. Please use the below query:

SELECT
a.Country,    a.Date,    a.Source,    a.Campaign,    sum(a.Leads)    sum(b.purchases),    sum(b.revenue)
FROM
 Table A 
 LEFT JOIN 
 Table B 
ON a.country = b.country and a.date = b.date and a.source = b.source and a.campaign = 
b.campaign;

Q: "Failed to open QEMU pipe 'qemud:network': Invalid argument" error when trying to run app on android emulator A:

This error could be due to two reasons :

  1. Either due to your android emulator / device version.
  2. Due to some error in your java or xml file.

First, change your current minSdkVersion to some other version preferably below 23. Then check your logcat whether it gives some error in your code. Most probably that could be an import error.

In my case, I changed my minSdkVersion from 26 to 17. And it worked for me. Hopefully, it works for you as well.
